reviews.title: Great First mechanical Keyboard coming from MX Keys/MacBook.
reviews.comment: This is my first mechanical keyboard coming from 5+ years typing on MacBooks and MX Keys keyboards.  Coming from scissor switches, I chose the Low-Profile keyboard with Red Nano switches, which the Nuphy store recommended as the best place for me to start. Love it so far.  the feel of the keyboard is very satisfying, and the travel of the keys isnt a deal breaker for me, although it certainly is longer than a MacBook keyboard.  The weight feels substantial but not heavy, and it sits well on the desk, giving you a solid foundation. Im not a gamer, so the RGBs are not a deal breaker for me, but I will say the subtle Rain pattern is nice, and decently unobtrusive.  From a height standpoint, its taller than the MX Keys for sure, and a wrist rest is in my future to feel totally comfortable with this keyboard. This keyboard is the Nuphyio version, and the online software is easy to use, letting me map some keys right out of the box  (launch calculator, screenshots, etc.). A nice feature for me is that Nuphy released print files for the keyboard, and MakerWorld has a bunch of printables that you can create to mod the Kick75 with, customizing it even further.  So far, I have tried the Tablet/phone stand (Fantastic) and a low profile knob (Loose but nice. Needs tweaking). For $109, I really think this was a great purchase.  Knowing that Nuphy nSa keycaps fit this board, I also bought the Shiokaze Keycap set to round out the look of the board.  Can't wait!
reviews.author: PtJudeRI

reviews.title: Great Sound and Feel in a Compact Low-Profile Keyboard
reviews.comment: The NuPhy Kick75 delivers an outstanding typing experience. The sound is crisp and satisfying without being too loud, and the feel of the switches is smooth yet responsive. The low-profile design is comfortable for long typing sessions, while the 75% layout strikes a perfect balance between compactness and functionality. Pros: Excellent sound and feel: Very satisfying keypress with a premium acoustic profile. Low-profile comfort: Easy on the wrists, great for extended use. Customizable: Hot-swappable switches allow easy personalization. Multiple connection modes: Bluetooth, 2.4G wireless, and USB-C for versatility. RGB backlighting: Bright, with plenty of customization options. Things to consider: Slightly heavier than some low-profile keyboards, but it adds to the premium feel. Volume knob could be a bit smoother in rotation. Overall, this is one of the best low-profile mechanical keyboards I’ve tried. The combination of excellent acoustics, tactile feedback, and versatile connectivity makes it worth the investment. Verdict: A top choice for anyone who values sound, feel, and design in a compact mechanical keyboard.
reviews.author: kiwi

reviews.title: A Solid Mechanical Keyboard at a Great Price
reviews.comment: The NuPhy Kick75 delivers excellent value, especially with the brown switches that strike a nice balance between tactile feedback and sound. Typing Feel The brown switches are satisfying—crisp and pleasantly noisy without being over the top. It’s a fun board to type on and feels responsive whether you’re writing or gaming. Portability & Build Light enough to throw in a bag and take on the go, but still feels sturdy on the desk. The 75% layout is compact yet functional, keeping arrows and function keys without wasting space. Value vs. Air Series The Air series does feel more premium in materials and finish, but it’s almost double the cost. Unless budget isn’t a concern, the Kick75 is a fantastic alternative that hits most of the same notes for a much lower price. Bottom Line If you’re cost-conscious but still want a mechanical keyboard that feels and sounds great, the Kick75 is an easy recommendation. Premium feel at a practical price point.
reviews.author: Brett Reviews

reviews.title: Good quality, great sound
reviews.comment: I have many keyboards and I am loving this one more than most. It's very stylish with it's clear casing and accent colors on the keycaps. In addition to this, the blush nano makes for a very nice and silent typing experience. I have been using it wirelessly and have had 0 connection issues. The only thing I wish is that the keycaps were see-through, otherwise the RGB is kinda useless.
